note: Picture layout labels for HKS plan step 2.4, by eye from 1 fps 320x180 frames (cutdeck.hks_layout.frames). t = source second of the footage file. Tuning days: a grid every 150 s from 37 s, plus targeted samples (the user's covers, the clock dips, the opening, the credits). Holdout days (hks_gold.HOLDOUT): a grid every 150 s from 97 s, labelled before any tuning and scored once. studio = a studio camera full frame (split screens of studio cameras and close inserts of the desk included); clip = windows over the blue frame (news clip, phone-call layout); footage = full-frame picture that is not the studio (video, photo, screenshot, map, voice-clip graphic); bumper = opening, bumper sting, TV ads and sponsor spots inside a break, end credits.
